what_it_does: Extends the Dyninst binary instrumentation toolkit—a tool for analyzing and modifying programs without access to source code—to run on RISC-V processors. This enables developers to profile performance, debug programs, and analyze execution characteristics on RISC-V systems, which previously lacked these capabilities. The work addresses RISC-V-specific challenges in parsing binary files, manipulating individual machine instructions, and handling memory address relocation.
